name: spor
description: Shared team memory: find decisions, brief work, capture discoveries, and manage the decision queue through the Spor knowledge graph.

interface.longDescription: Connect to your Spor team graph to find prior decisions, prepare task briefings, capture follow-up work, and inspect the decision queue. Requires a Spor account and access to a team graph.
defaultPrompt: Brief this Spor task before I start work.
Capture this follow-up in the graph.
Show me what is next in the Spor queue.
